module: Node "Register Bus Data" (category `once_instant`). Registers the callback for notification of bus value changes (kneeling, doors) via `mgr.modules.vehicle:registerBusChangeNotification(vehId)`. To be called after the bus spawns; required for "Bus Controls Detection". Pins: inputs `flow`, `vehId` (default 0); output `flow`.
notes: The registration is deferred with `mgr.modules.level:delayOrInstantFunction` (waits until the level is ready).
The found vehicle (`veh`) in the closure is not used.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

workOnce.desc: Schedules (or runs right away) the registration of the bus notification, then activates the output flow.
